_comment: Provenance for the price fixtures in this directory (design R3 §4.3).
Read by nothing at runtime; it exists so a stale fixture is identifiable.
The filename prefixes matter: src/prices.ts picks the newest file starting

litellm-snapshot.json.subset: top-level keys matching /^claude/ (the 24 litellm_provider='anthropic' ids plus claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0)
litellm-snapshot.json.fidelity: EXACT. Fetched as raw bytes via the GitHub blob API (api.github.com is inside the bash sandbox allowlist), then subset with jq. Costs are verbatim upstream values, per TOKEN.
litellm-snapshot.json.note: A WebFetch of the same URL was also performed and returned a model-summarised digest that OMITTED claude-sonnet-4-5, claude-opus-4-5, claude-opus-4-1 and claude-haiku-4-5 and reported litellm_provider='bedrock' for anthropic-provider ids. That digest was discarded in favour of these raw bytes.

modelsdev-snapshot.json.fidelity: SUMMARISED. models.dev is outside the bash sandbox allowlist, so this was retrieved through the WebFetch tool, whose reader is a small model. Treat the model list as possibly incomplete; the four rates per model were spot-checked against litellm-snapshot.json and agree. Costs are per MILLION tokens (models.dev's own unit), unlike LiteLLM's per-token.
modelsdev-snapshot.json.role: SECONDARY source only (§4.3): consulted for families LiteLLM does not carry.
